title: S4-DRAW-09 — A transformed detail can come back.
goal: An asymmetric L selected with one Magic Wand click can be lifted and rotated: Cancel puts back the exact original, Rotate 90 degrees clockwise and Commit changes it once, and one Undo restores the exact original.

steps.why: The replay draws exactly the L.
The selection is lifted for transforming.
Cancel puts back the exact original.
The rotated L is committed with the same number of pixels.
One Undo restores the exact original.

cliOnly: dragging the selection to move it and canvas-edge clipping (tests/e2e/selectionTransformUndo.spec.ts, tests/production/selectionLimitsTools.spec.ts)
